tasks.label: Console  →  isthislegit Server window + http://127.0.0.1:4000
tasks.detail: Opens the operator console app. Starts everything and administers it: server, LiveKit, Caddy, database, migrations, seed, invite codes, accounts, storage, retention, updates, configuration. Closing the window hides it to the tray; Quit from the tray stops the services it started.

tasks.label: Desktop app (dev)
tasks.detail: electron-vite dev. Opens the Electron client; it talks to http://localhost:3000 unless you change the server address on the sign-in screen.

tasks.label: Build server
tasks.detail: tsc for packages/shared, then nest build for apps/server. The same thing the console's Build button runs -- use that one when the console is already open, since it can Restart afterwards and this cannot.

tasks.label: Build client
tasks.detail: tsc --noEmit, then electron-vite build into apps/desktop/out. The typecheck is a separate step on purpose: electron-vite strips types with esbuild and never checks them, so a build alone will happily package code that does not compile.

tasks.label: Typecheck client
tasks.detail: tsc --noEmit over apps/desktop. Run by Build client; here on its own because it is the fast one.

tasks.label: Package client installer  →  apps/desktop/release
tasks.detail: electron-builder. Produces isthislegit-<version>-setup.exe, its .blockmap and latest.yml -- the three files an update is made of. Bump the version in apps/desktop/package.json first: publishing refuses a version that is not newer than the one already published. Then send it to the server with infra\publish-desktop-update.ps1; the server box cannot build this itself.
